value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "The first class of this program positioned teachers as co-designers of learning spaces and artifacts for community-based learning spaces such as museums, non-profit organizations, and after-school programs."
